meta.title: Dingo MCP Request & Question Resolution Workflow
meta.subtitle: End-to-End Execution Sequence: AI Agent Reasoning, Intent Taxonomy Routing, Safety Guardrails & Cardano Ledger Queries

views.label: Complete Question-to-Answer Pipeline
views.note: End-to-end journey from user prompt to intent recognition, security verification, tool execution, and final synthesized answer.

views.label: Question Taxonomy & Intent Routing
views.note: How questions from Cardano Developers, SPOs, DEXs, DeFi protocols, and Voltaire Governance map directly to specific tools.

views.label: Zero-Risk Security Perimeter
views.note: Multi-tier defense: constant-time bearer token check, leaky bucket rate limiter, and AST mutation rejection.

nodes.label: Natural Language Question
nodes.description: User enters a prompt (e.g. 'What is the current sync tip?', 'Find UTxOs holding asset policy X', 'Is my pool minting blocks?').

nodes.label: AI Agent Reasoning
nodes.description: LLM inspects the 21 registered tool schemas and 81 resources provided during MCP initialization to match query intent.

nodes.label: Intent Taxonomy Routing
nodes.description: Agent maps query intent to a specific tool (e.g. get_cardano_tip, get_utxos_by_asset, get_governance_state, or sqlite_query).

nodes.label: JSON-RPC 2.0 Request
nodes.description: Client sends an MCP 'tools/call' payload over HTTP SSE with session ID and optional Bearer token.

nodes.label: Ingress Security Gate
nodes.description: Validates Bearer token using subtle.ConstantTimeCompare and enforces token-bucket rate limiting (default 60 req/s, burst 15).

nodes.label: AST Mutation Validator
nodes.description: For SQLite tools, parses SQL with an AST visitor. Strictly forbids DROP, DELETE, INSERT, UPDATE, ALTER, and ATTACH.

nodes.label: Blocked Mutation (Error)
nodes.description: Queries containing prohibited write statements are aborted immediately with a clear rejection message.

nodes.label: MCP Server Dispatcher
nodes.description: Dispatches verified request to either the Cardano Domain Handler (18 tools) or the SQLite Query Handler (3 tools).

nodes.label: Cardano Domain Handler
nodes.description: Invokes pure-Go Cardano logic: reads live Ouroboros consensus tip, evaluates Plutus budgets, or extracts Conway governance.

nodes.label: SQLite Query Handler
nodes.description: Executes SELECT queries against metadata.sqlite with PRAGMA query_only = ON and automatic row/column caps.

nodes.label: Ledger & Database Fetch
nodes.description: Reads unspent UTxO indices, pool parameters, account states, and governance proposals from storage.

nodes.label: Output Formatting & Sanitizer
nodes.description: Converts binary hashes to uppercase hex, formats rows into markdown tables, and neutralizes prompt-injection payloads.

nodes.label: AI Context Synthesis
nodes.description: AI agent synthesizes the structured tool output into a fluent, contextual response with citations and actionable advice.

nodes.label: Delivered Answer
nodes.description: User receives a complete, verified answer to their question with verified slot numbers, hashes, and balances.
